title: [FEAT] Background compaction real — maybe_compact é síncrono e bloqueia escritas

todos.title: Create EngineCore<C> struct
todos.description: Extract all mutable fields from Engine<C> into a new struct EngineCore<C>: memtables, memtable_bytes, version_set, compaction, wal

todos.title: Wrap EngineCore in Arc<Mutex<>>
todos.description: Change Engine<C> to hold `core: Arc<Mutex<EngineCore<C>>>` and `compaction_running: Arc<AtomicBool>`. Add `use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, atomic::AtomicBool};`. Remove old fields from Engine.

todos.title: Add close() and Drop with JoinHandle
todos.description: Add `compaction_thread: Mutex<Option<JoinHandle<()>>>` field to Engine. Implement `close()` method that sets compaction_running=false and joins thread. Add Drop that calls close(). Import JoinHandle.

todos.title: Refactor new_generic and write methods
todos.description: Refactor new_generic to construct EngineCore and wrap in Arc<Mutex>. Refactor put_cf, delete_cf, flush_memtable_impl to lock core with `let mut core = self.core.lock().unwrap();`

todos.title: Refactor read methods
todos.description: Refactor get_cf, scan_cf, scan_range, search_prefix, keys, count, stats, stats_all to lock core internally

todos.title: Refactor compact/compact_cf/maybe_compact
todos.description: Refactor compact and compact_cf to work via locked core. Change maybe_compact to spawn thread: `std::thread::spawn(move || { ... })`

todos.title: Error handling in compaction thread
todos.description: In the spawned compaction thread, wrap core in `catch_unwind` or use `tracing::error!` for errors. No unwrap() in compaction thread. Log errors with tracing::error!

todos.title: Add tests
todos.description: Add 2 tests: (1) test_500_writes_during_compaction writes 500 keys while compaction runs, no Err returns. (2) test_shutdown_with_compaction_in_progress starts compaction, immediately drops engine, no panic.

todos.title: Final validation
todos.description: Run cargo test --all-features, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, fix issues. Update .task-state.json all done.
